rule: a case passes when its first rejecting layer (the earliest code letter, in the input kind's pipeline order, among the error findings) is the listed layer and the listed code is among the error codes; patches are RFC 6902 against the named base in design-examples/ (queue and C4 patches address /lines/<n>); a schema_patch applies to fixture.relation-schema.json and the harness re-stamps the base's schema digest; expect_target pins what each indexed path points at in the base

pipelines.queue: J V Q C S D

harness.engine: jsonschema (full report); fastjsonschema codes must be contained in jsonschema's
self_checks: the input differs from its base
every unpatched base has no error finding

context.doc_texts: fixture.doc-texts.json for bases; a case's doc_text only for itself
